diagnosis.root_cause: Downstream payments-api latency increase starting at 09:16 UTC led to thread and database connection pool exhaustion in checkout-api, causing server capacity errors and 503 responses.
evidence: payments-api / p95_latency_ms spiked at 09:16 UTC from ~90ms to over 400ms
checkout-api / outbound_requests_per_s surged starting around 09:18 UTC
checkout-api / db_pool_wait_ms spiked at 09:20 UTC to over 5000ms
checkout-api ERROR log at 09:21:00Z: DB connection pool exhausted (size=20, active=20, waiters=140)

checkout-api ERROR log at 09:23:00Z: HTTP 503: server at capacity
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Investigate and resolve the underlying performance degradation in the payments-api service to reduce request duration, and increase database and worker thread pool limits or implement circuit breakers in checkout-api as a follow-up hardening measure.
